items: 1 pound large marshmallows, cut into quarters

steps.title: Melt the chocolate
steps.body: Melt in double boiler: **1 pound milk chocolate**.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: When melted, add: **1 pound large marshmallows**, cut into quarters, **1 cup chopped walnuts** and **1 can sweetened condensed milk**.

steps.title: Pour and cool
steps.body: Stir gently, then place in a well greased 9×13 pan, and allow to cool.
